name: NASA project management and systems engineering
description: Life-cycle phases, key decision points, life-cycle reviews, requirements with verification, RIDs, waivers, 5x5 risks and document templates structured after NPR 7120.5 and NPR 7123.1. A tailorable starting point, not a substitute for the directives.

fields.name: Requirement (shall statement)
fields.description: One verifiable statement: The <system> shall <do what> <how well> <under what conditions>.

fields.name: Rationale
fields.description: Why the requirement exists and where its numbers come from.

fields.name: Verification evidence
fields.description: Report numbers, data locations or links that show compliance.

fields.name: Request type
fields.description: Deviation: relief sought before the requirement is put under control. Waiver: relief sought afterward. Tailoring: adjusting a prescribed requirement to the project.

item_types.name: Requirement
item_types.description: A verifiable shall statement with rationale, parent trace and verification method.

item_types.name: Verification activity
item_types.description: A test, analysis, inspection or demonstration that verifies one or more requirements. Link it to them with the relation `verifies`.

item_types.name: Life-cycle review
item_types.description: A life-cycle or technical review such as SRR, PDR or CDR.

item_types.name: RID
item_types.description: Review item discrepancy raised against review material.

item_types.name: Key decision point
item_types.description: The decision authority's gate between life-cycle phases.

item_types.name: Waiver or deviation
item_types.description: A request for relief from, or tailoring of, a requirement.

item_types.name: Risk (5x5)
item_types.description: A risk scored on likelihood and consequence, 1 to 5 each, with a handling approach.

item_types.name: Controlled product
item_types.description: A plan or document that must be baselined, such as the Project Plan or SEMP.

item_types.name: Technology development
item_types.description: A technology being matured, tracked by readiness level.

item_types.name: Lesson learned
item_types.description: What happened, why it matters and what to do differently.
